font.$description: Font-family INTENT only (each consumer bundles its own binaries). The Braird brand is a TWO-FACE system: Hanken Grotesk for all UI/body, Lora for all serif/editorial (wordmark, titles, reading body, stat values). This canonicalises on the Braird app design (braird/screens/app.css: --ui Hanken, --serif Lora) and supersedes the earlier IBM Plex Sans base + EB Garamond reading + Sometype Mono front-door (SUR-508 revisited — see below).

base.$description: the Braird UI/body face — app chrome, buttons, fields, nav (was IBM Plex Sans)

serif.$description: reading content — quotes, note body (was EB Garamond; the design uses Lora)

front-door.$description: front-door surfaces (landing/auth/waitlist). Consolidated to the editorial serif; the Sometype Mono front-door face (SUR-508) is RETIRED under the two-face system. Token kept so consumers referencing var(--font-front-door) don't break — founder sign-off (spine).

stat.$description: stat-box number face (Braird Screens .stat .v). Paired with --text-stat-* (28px / 600 / line-height 1).
